name: aiia-sovereign-medikiosk-suite
description: Sovereign Hospital OS: Air-gapped clinical triage, pre-consultation intake, and dual-pharmacology safety engine for public health institutions.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend

author: Health Innovations Division | MP Health & AIIA
